title: Scale observed three-bet and four-bet ranges by PFR relative to a typical player
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.29 (decision: Q-3 C). Today every three-bet and four-bet line scales toward raw PFR, so a 22/18 player's 6-max UTG four-bet range goes 2.56% to 18% at 100 hands and even a 12/9 player's goes to 9%. Apply REQ-035.6 as reworded by TASK-7.29: for three-bet and four-bet lines o = min(100, d x observed PFR / typical PFR), typical PFR = midpoint of the healthy PFR band in src/stats/healthy-ranges.json (heads-up 57.5, 6-max 18, full ring 12.5); open-raise keeps raw PFR and calling lines raw VPIP; blend formula and 30-hand threshold unchanged. No new stat, no persisted-format change; no locked test should need a re-pin (observed-ranges AC#2 covers only open-raise and call-raise). Expected values: doit/TASK-7.29/spec.md §5. Re-verify the 4 observed golden postflop spots.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a 6-max UTG four-bettor seen for 100 hands with PFR 18, When the range is estimated, Then its scaled width is 2.56% (the default), within 0.01
Given the same seat with PFR 45 or PFR 9 at 100 hands, When the range is estimated, Then the width is 6.41% or 1.28% respectively, within 0.01
Given heads-up and full-ring tables, When a three-bet or four-bet range is scaled, Then the typical PFR is 57.5 and 12.5 respectively, and o is capped at 100
Given open-raise and calling lines, When ranges are scaled, Then they are unchanged from FU-A (raw PFR and raw VPIP)
Given the 4 observed golden postflop spots, When npm test runs, Then each still agrees and is clear-cut, or each changed one is re-justified with the user's sign-off
Given docs/advice/range-model.md, When the story is done, Then its line-to-stat table and Known limits state the relative re-raise rule

Given a full-ring UTG four-bet line (default width 1.21%) and an opponent observed for 100 hands, When the observed PFR is 12.5 or 25, Then the scaled widths are 1.21% and 2.42%; and given any three-bet or four-bet line where default × PFR ÷ typical PFR exceeds 100, Then the scaled width is 100% (heads-up uses typical PFR 57.5 and is covered by one concrete width in the same test)

Given resizeRange in src/advice/ranges.ts, When its empty-default branch is either covered by a unit test or removed as unreachable, Then no untested branch remains; and the tautological 'expected contains default' check at tests/advice/observed-resize.acceptance.test.ts:143 is replaced by a check that can fail (owner TASK-7.43 unlock), with no assertion dropped
